full_prompt_en: A square expressive portrait fills the frame with a close male face cut by vivid splashes of paint. The face tilts slightly downward while the eyes look directly out from beneath dark brows, making the gaze the strongest fixed point in an otherwise restless surface. Black hair and deep shadow crowd the upper left and side edges; the mouth is closed in a faint, ambiguous smile near the lower center. Photographic gray skin and sharply modeled cheekbones remain visible under aggressive swathes of cyan across the forehead, bright lemon yellow along the right cheek, hot magenta around the jaw, and smaller red and orange flecks near the nose. Paint drips and spatters continue off the face onto the mostly white background, so the portrait seems to break apart rather than sit inside a clean outline. Dark ink-like strokes cut through the colored areas, preserving the nose, eyes, and lip shape while loosening the outer contours. The lower edge is filled by a black collar or garment, interrupted by neon color that runs down toward the crop. Bright frontal light gives the uncovered facial planes a cold silver clarity; the color appears as matte and glossy paint laid over that tonal base rather than as colored lighting alone. Tiny droplets, smeared edges, and rough brush marks bring physical energy to the image. The white gaps around the head prevent the intense palette from becoming a solid field and make each splash more visible. The overall composition is confrontational and kinetic, holding a steady human gaze within a burst of electric color and black shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性肖像以男子近景面孔填满画面，鲜艳颜料泼溅其上。脸略向下倾，眼睛从深眉下直视观者，让目光成为其余躁动表面中最稳定的点。黑发与深影挤在左上及侧边；下方中央的嘴闭合，带轻微而难以确定的笑。摄影般灰色皮肤和清楚塑出的颧骨在激烈色带下仍可见：青蓝横过额头，亮柠檬黄沿右脸颊，强洋红绕过下颌，鼻旁还有较小红橙斑点。颜料滴痕与飞点从脸延到大体白色背景，使肖像像向外碎开，而非处于干净轮廓内。深墨色笔痕切过彩色区域，保留鼻、眼和嘴唇形状，同时放松外围边缘。下缘由黑领口或衣服占据，霓虹颜色又穿过其中流向裁切。明亮正面光使没有被遮盖的面部平面有冷银色清晰度；颜色更像铺在影调底之上的哑光与亮面颜料，而不只是彩色灯光。小水珠、抹开的边和粗笔痕给图像带来实体能量。头周围的白色空隙避免强烈配色连成实心色域，也让每处泼溅更明显。整体构图直面观者且充满动势，把稳定的人眼凝在电光色彩与黑影的爆发里。
style_prompt_en: The image combines sharply modeled grayscale photographic planes with violent hand-painted color. Electric cyan, lemon yellow, magenta, orange, and red burst across a black-and-white base in irregular strokes, splashes, and drips. Central features stay crisp, while outer edges fracture into white negative space and scattered pigment. Hard black marks reinforce a few contours, and broad chromatic smears supply speed and volume without a conventional background scene. Frontal clarity on the smooth base contrasts with rough, uneven paint thickness and spatter. The overall effect is confrontational, high-energy, and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 图像把清楚塑形的灰度摄影平面与激烈手绘颜色结合。电青蓝、柠檬黄、洋红、橙和红以不规则笔触、泼点和滴痕在黑白底上爆发。中央特征保持锐利，外围边缘则裂入白色留白与散落颜料。硬黑线加强少数轮廓，宽阔彩色抹痕带来速度和体积，而不依靠传统背景场景。平滑底上的正面清晰度对照粗糙、不均厚的颜料和飞溅。整体效果强烈直面观者、能量高且可触。
theme_en: A close male face streaked with electric yellow, cyan, and magenta paint
theme_zh: 男子面孔近景被电黄、青蓝与洋红颜料划过
name: Patrice Murciano
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
